rules.description: Every attributed record refuses construction without its attribution
Codec-backed records expose static encode and decode
Coverage suppressions and exclusions are forbidden
Quality checks form one nonrecursive acyclic graph
Every operating-doctrine rule is classified as active or milestone-gated and its active controls run fail-closed
A surviving mutant is excused only by its own falsifiable, individually proven equivalence register entry
Runtime failures use the closed AgentCoreError taxonomy
A committed TSLean-generated package is byte-bound to its manifest, its proved certificates, and the committed Lean source it lowers

Every semantic heuristic and hidden external assumption in the audited sources is eliminated, declared with the clause that declares it, bound to a named premise carrying executable evidence, or withheld against the live archive with the exact edit it owes
Opaque identifiers have one context-owned declaration
Codec-backed records are runtime immutable
Cross-context references use barrels without runtime cycles
Committed live substrate evidence is fully passing, and hash-bound to the exact current sources wherever a conformance row still claims verified from it
Every keyword rule of a normative SPEC section anchors an atom in its own block, list item, or table row, or carries a digest-bound recorded disposition
Recorded integration outcomes are bound to their own ratification commits, fingerprinted against the outcome baseline, and never verified fail-open
Every durable record has one Actor and authoritative store
A record field declared by presence carries no negative or null form
A committed proof repair ledger decodes through its versioned codec and every artifact it accepts is byte-identical to the reviewed formal tree
Every changed path has one exclusive worktree owner
Every seam implementation runs one shared contract
Every public export's words are SPEC vocabulary; foreign terms are never reviewable and reviewed words carry a written, current reason
The substrate premise discharge map names exactly the premises Lean states, with the channel Lean states and the status the conformance ledger carries today
Focused, skipped, and placeholder tests are forbidden
Weak types are confined to permitted trust boundaries
Closed vocabularies have one canonical owner
